title: Real Estate Marketplace (OLX-like) with Listings, Images, and Offer Options in INR

requirements.text: Add Internet Identity authentication so users can sign in/out and the app can associate actions (creating listings, sending offers/messages) to an authenticated Principal.

quotes: allows owners to create account and create a post

acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity
After sign-in, the UI shows the signed-in state (e.g., short principal / account menu)
Backend can identify the caller Principal for create/update actions and rejects unauthenticated calls where required

requirements.text: Implement a property listing data model and CRUD endpoints for sellers to create and manage listings for land and newly built homes, including title, category/type, description, quoted price in Indian Rupees (INR), location text fields, and timestamps.

quotes: real estate lands and new built homes selling
add description about selling product and quoting price options

acceptanceCriteria: Seller can create a listing after authentication
Seller can edit and delete only their own listings
Listings store and return: title, listing type (Land/Home), description, quoted price (numeric), currency=INR, basic location text (e.g., city/area), createdAt/updatedAt
Public listing feed and listing detail can be fetched without needing seller permissions

requirements.text: Support uploading and displaying multiple images per listing, including selecting multiple files in the UI, uploading them, and rendering them in a gallery/carousel on the listing detail page.

quotes: upload pictures of the land or homes like olx application

acceptanceCriteria: Seller can upload at least 1 image for a listing and see it displayed on the listing detail page
A listing can have multiple images and the UI lets users browse them (gallery/grid and/or carousel)
Backend validates that only the listing owner can attach images to their listing
If a listing has no images, the UI shows a consistent placeholder image

requirements.text: Create buyer browsing experience: a home/feed page with search and filters for listing type (Land/Home) and price range, and a listing detail page with images, description, price in INR, and seller contact/offer actions.

quotes: customers can contact or make offer

acceptanceCriteria: Users can browse a feed of listings
Users can search by keyword (e.g., title/location/description) and filter by type and price range
Listing cards show thumbnail, title, type, and formatted INR price
Listing detail page shows full description, image gallery, and clear CTAs for contact and offer

requirements.text: Implement a contact-seller flow where a buyer can send a message to the seller for a specific listing, and the seller can view received contact messages per listing.
acceptanceCriteria: Buyer can submit a contact message from a listing detail page
Seller can view a list of messages received for their listings (with listing reference, message text, created time, and buyer Principal)
Only the listing owner can view messages for that listing
Backend persists messages and returns them in reverse chronological order

requirements.text: Implement an offer flow where, for a listing’s quoted price, the UI generates exactly 3 lower offer options by reducing the quoted price by 35% (applied successively per option) and the buyer can select one option (or choose a custom offer, if included) and submit it to the seller.

quotes: make offer which will have 3 options of less prices than quoted price by reducing 35% from each options

acceptanceCriteria: On listing detail, user sees 3 offer options generated from the quoted price using repeated 35% reductions (option1=price*0.65; option2=option1*0.65; option3=option2*0.65)
Offer option amounts are displayed formatted in INR with sensible rounding to whole rupees
Buyer can submit an offer for a specific listing choosing one of the 3 options
Seller can view offers received per listing (amount, option index, buyer Principal, timestamp)
Only authenticated users can submit offers

requirements.text: Format all prices consistently as Indian Rupees (INR) across the UI, including listing cards, listing detail, and offer options.

quotes: application should contain a currency of indian rupees

acceptanceCriteria: All price displays show INR formatting (₹ and Indian number formatting where applicable)
No other currency symbols are shown anywhere in the listing/offer UI

requirements.text: Add seller dashboard pages to manage listings and handle inbound messages/offers: “My Listings”, “Inbox (Messages)”, and “Offers”.

quotes: allows owners to create account and create a post

acceptanceCriteria: Signed-in seller can view their listings and navigate to edit/delete
Signed-in seller can view messages and offers grouped or filterable by listing
Dashboard routes are protected behind authentication (prompt to sign in if not authenticated)

requirements.text: Establish a coherent, modern visual theme for the marketplace UI (typography, spacing, colors, components) optimized for a ‘premium real estate’ feel, and apply it consistently across the feed, listing detail, and dashboard screens.
acceptanceCriteria: UI has a consistent theme (color palette, typography scale, and component styling) across pages
Primary actions (Post Listing, Contact, Make Offer) are visually prominent and consistent
Layouts are responsive and usable on mobile and desktop
Theme avoids default/unstyled template look

requirements.text: Add generated static brand and placeholder images and wire them into the UI as static assets served from the frontend (not from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated
UI uses the generated logo in the header/auth area
UI uses the generated placeholder image anywhere a listing lacks uploaded images
UI uses an empty-state illustration for ‘no results’ (optional but present if generated)

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all business logic in backend/main.mo)
Use Internet Identity as the only authentication method (no third-party auth providers)
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead)
Do not edit immutable hook files/paths listed by the system; integrate with them via normal component usage
nonGoals: External database or third-party file storage integrations
Advanced moderation workflows beyond basic ownership checks

required: Minimal premium real estate wordmark logo (realty-logo.dim_512x256.png)
Neutral property placeholder photo/illustration tile with subtle texture (property-placeholder.dim_1200x800.png)
Empty state illustration for no search results (no-results.dim_900x600.png)
